t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pay attention to which gnomes give you 9 for 1x or 45 for 5x. They can switch places but are in the same pairs.

vb_textbox.text: The maximum numbers available are 9 for 1x and 45 for 5x. Try and remember which gnomes collect the higher amounts as it seems like they're consistent for a few goes at a time (I don't think they stay the same through every single round though). The same colours seem to be paired up throughout although they can switch sides.
